channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Being a DIK - Season 3
item.description: Being a DIK is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel that focuses on the fun parts of college life. The third season continues the story and is packed with more content than both of the previous seasons.

item.title: Craft The World
item.description: Craft The World is a unique sandbox strategy game, the mix of Dungeon Keeper, Terraria and Dwarf Fortress. Explore a random generated world populated by dangerous creatures, build a dwarf fortress, gather resources, and craft all the items, weapons, and armor you need.

item.title: Deck & Conn
item.description: Take command of a nuclear-powered space corvette in a Cold War-flavored sci-fi campaign. Balance tactics, crew, and limited resources in a dynamic forever-war. Retro pixel art meets deep strategy fifteen minutes into the future of 1989.

item.title: DYSPLACED
item.description: Grenades are holy relics. Shotguns are spellcraft. In this top-down survival action-RPG, discover a fantasy realm invaded by modern world and destroy nearly everything. Scavenge artifacts, forge weapons, build outposts, brew potions, and hunt the corruption devouring the land. Play solo or co-op.

item.title: Eden Crafters
item.description: Eden Crafters is a solo or co-op open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform a hostile planet into a habitable haven for humanity. Build, automate, and terraform. Control the climate, create a breathable atmosphere, and turn toxic lakes into water: shape a new world!

item.title: Grail
item.description: In this deckbuilder your deck plays automatically. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?

item.title: WheelMates
item.description: Dive into a 2-player co-op driving adventure with RC cars. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles, find hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside. With Friend’s Pass, your friend joins for free.

item.title: Zad Archery
item.description: Shoot down waves of targets, collect their loot, and grow stronger through upgrades and skills in this expanding incremental game.

item.title: Serious Sam HD: The First Encounter
item.description: Serious Sam HD: The First Encounter is a visually upgraded and fully Steam supported remake version of the original high-adrenaline single-play and 16-player co-operative arcade-action FPS which was Gamespot's Game of the Year 2001 and which scored overall of 87% on Metacritic!

item.title: Serious Sam Fusion 2017 (beta)
item.description: Serious Sam Fusion is a central hub for several existing Serious Sam games developed by Croteam. Cool new features, engine upgrades, patches and updates will be released to existing owners for FREE!

item.title: Breathedge 2
item.description: Survive on the edge of space! Craft and upgrade tools, scavenge resources, and save a galaxy gone completely off the rails. Can Ordinary Man save the galaxy with the help of the immortal Chicken and some duct tape?

item.title: City Car Driving 2.0
item.description: City Car Driving 2.0 is a driving simulator designed to help novice drivers master driving in a setting as close to reality as possible.

item.title: Endzone - A World Apart
item.description: Endzone is a post-apocalyptic survival city builder, where you start a new civilization with a group of people after an ecological disaster. Build them a new home and ensure their survival in a shattered world, threatened by constant radiation, toxic rain, sandstorms and droughts.

item.title: Len's Island
item.description: An open-world survival crafting game for 1–8 players, blending intense dungeon crawling and ARPG combat with peaceful farming and creative building. Take on quests and explore a vast, procedurally-generated world full of danger and discovery.

item.title: Nightingale
item.description: Nightingale is an open world survival crafting game, where you’ll adventure across the mysterious and dangerous Fae Realms. As a daring Realmwalker, you’ll defeat monstrous enemies, survive hostile environments, and build elaborate estates in a visually stunning Gaslamp Fantasy world.

item.title: Scrap Mechanic
item.description: Enter the creative paradise of Scrap Mechanic! Build fantastic machines, go on adventures with your friends and defend against waves of evil Farmbots in this imaginative multiplayer survival sandbox. With Scrap Mechanic’s powerful creation tools you can engineer your own adventures!

item.title: SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE
item.description: SD Gundam Battle Alliance is a multiplayer Gundam action RPG where you can smash foes solo or with friends in thrilling mechanized combat. Acquire new mobile suits, power them up, and take them into battle in various missions!

item.title: Serious Sam 3: BFE
item.description: Serious Sam 3: BFE is a prequel to the original indie fast action FPS and Game of the Year sensation - Serious Sam: The First Encounter!

item.title: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
item.description: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

item.title: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!
item.description: Lock and load into the Starship Troopers universe and join the Mobile Infantry in the most realistic depiction of war ever made! Experience an original story in this action-packed, first-person retro shooter. Would you like to know more?

item.title: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
item.description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

item.title: Sunkenland
item.description: Get ready for a Waterworld-themed survival game with modular base building, sunken city scavenging, crafting, base defense, and invasions of NPC clans for resources and territory. Ready for the water apocalypse?

item.title: The Long Dark
item.description: THE LONG DARK is a thoughtful, exploration-survival experience that challenges solo players to think for themselves as they explore an expansive frozen wilderness in the aftermath of a geomagnetic disaster. There are no zombies -- only you, the cold, and all the threats Mother Nature can muster.

item.title: The Long Dark: Tales from the Far Territory
item.description: Deep along the rocky spine of Great Bear stands the Far Range. Mysteries abound, in remote airfields, abandoned mines, and forgotten railways. The air crackles as the Aurora blazes overhead. Will you survive long enough to unearth the secrets of the Far Territory?

item.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator Suite: Themes Reimagined
item.description: Fully immerse yourself in the world of flight with this digital soundtrack to accompany you on your aviation journey. This suite of 21 unreleased original pieces is inspired by popular trailer scores created by Finishing Move Inc. for Microsoft Flight Simulator.
